items.q: So like I remember the first time, I think it was like Clark and Eddie laid down a background riff for me.

ctx.x: But somewhere I know I was listening to rock. But anyway, he heard me play with the Quinnipiac Band and said, “Hey, Clark Terry’s playing next week, why don’t you come and sit in?” So we’d come to sit in with all these guys. I’d come and I’d sit in. I’ll never forget the first time I was playing and they had a great alto player named Ed Graf who also had a music store and sold records and stuff, we used to go to downtown Bridgeport to look at records and buy them all the time. And then he actually taught at this…
No, but I had the same experience with Clark Terry.
